name: Review CI Workflow Change
summary: Review a CI workflow change for observable trigger, permission, command, artifact, and rollback evidence.
description: Review a proposed CI workflow change without applying it, using a bounded line collector plus contextual review of triggers, permissions, secrets, failure behavior, and release impact. Use when a CI configuration change needs review.
refuses: It does not parse YAML as a complete semantic model or claim that omitted signals are absent.
It does not change workflow files, rotate secrets, trigger a run, or approve deployment permissions.
It does not expose secret values or treat a reference to a secret as authorization to use it.

entrypoints.purpose: Collect bounded line-level workflow signals without parsing or executing YAML.
